newsitem.title: TUNISIA: PRESS DIGEST - Tunisia - April 15. [CORRECTED 13:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Tunisia - April 15. [CORRECTED 13:25 GMT]

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali on Monday chaired development regional council meeting in southern region of Sfax.
- U.S pilot Linda Finch lands in Tunisia on Monday in her attempt to retrace Amelia Earhart 1937 flight around the world.
- Defence Minister Habib Ben Yahia on Monday held a meeting with Belgian ambassador in Tunisia on military cooperation between Tunisia and Belgium.
- President Ben Ali on Monday said that investment on industry and service sectors in Sfax totalled 530 million dinars since November 1987 (corrects from "since the beginning of 1997").
